# Copilot instructions for this repository

Purpose: concise guidance for Copilot sessions to quickly find build/test commands, understand high-level architecture, and follow repository-specific conventions.

1) Build, test, and lint commands
- Frontend (Angular, folder: Frontend)
  - Install: npm install (run inside Frontend/)
  - Dev server: npm start  (alias for `ng serve`) -> `cd Frontend && npm start`
  - Build: cd Frontend && npm run build
  - Unit tests (Karma/Jasmine): cd Frontend && npm test
  - Run a single test file: cd Frontend && ng test --include="src/app/path/to/file.spec.ts"  (or use `fdescribe`/`fit` in Jasmine)
  - E2E: cd Frontend && ng e2e
  - Lint: no repo-wide lint script detected. If ESLint is configured, use `ng lint` or add `npm run lint`.

- Backend (Spring Boot, folder: store)
  - Build: mvn -f store/pom.xml clean package
  - Run: mvn -f store spring-boot:run  (or run the generated jar in target/)
  - Tests: mvn -f store test
  - Run a single test: mvn -f store -Dtest=TestClassName#testMethod test

2) High-level architecture
- Backend
  - Java Spring Boot application at store/src/main/java/com/example/store (StoreApplication.java)
  - Controllers grouped by domain packages: Controller/stockMangment, SalesManagement, PurchaseManagement, BusinessPartnerManagement, AuthController, etc.
  - Uses Spring Data JPA, Liquibase, Redis, Spring Security (JWT via jjwt), MySQL (runtime) and H2 for tests.
  - API surface is under /api/** (see WebSecurityConfig permit list).

- Frontend
  - Angular 17 app in Frontend/ generated by Angular CLI.
  - Services live under src/app/core/services and call backend endpoints directly (many services hardcode base URLs like http://localhost:8080/api/... in service files).
  - Shared models and DTOs exist under src/app/shared/models and mirror backend domain shapes.

3) Key conventions and repo-specific patterns
- Domain-driven package layout in backend: each business area has its own controller/repository/service packages.
- Frontend services map 1:1 to backend controllers and use hard-coded base URLs (search in Frontend/src/app/core/services for apiUrl fields).
- DTO naming: frontend uses DTO suffix in shared/models/dto and backend uses DTO/Entity mapping conventions.
- Security: JWT + Spring Security; unauthenticated endpoints are declared in WebSecurityConfig.
- Database migrations: Liquibase is present in backend pom.xml.

4) Where to look first
- Frontend README: Frontend/README.md (dev server, test info)
- Backend pom: store/pom.xml (dependencies and Java version)
- Store controllers: store/src/main/java/com/example/store/Controller for API routes
- Frontend services: Frontend/src/app/core/services for API usage patterns

5) AI-specific notes for Copilot sessions
- Prefer inspecting controllers and corresponding frontend services to understand API contracts (Controller/... ↔ core/services/...).
- When suggesting code edits to the frontend, search for hard-coded `apiUrl` strings first and prefer centralizing them (environment file) when modifying multiple services.
